criteria.text: List each provider/account or existing integration section on the left with a clear name and short identity/connection-status subtitle.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c1: rows expose compact provider identity and connection status

criteria.text: Selecting an entry shows connection details, supported settings, and related actions in the main inspector.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c2: selecting two entries swaps the inspector details

criteria.text: Keep connect/reconnect/disconnect and sync actions, calendar selection, Gmail signals, Planning Center filters, and applicable import tools discoverable in the appropriate inspector context.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c3: every existing item action remains reachable from its inspector

criteria.text: Keep broad assistant Google access distinct from narrower integration consent. Selection must not initiate OAuth, sync, disconnect, or import.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c4: consent scopes stay distinct and selection is inert

criteria.text: Mouse and keyboard selection update the correct inspector, with visible focus and selected state.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c5: keyboard selection updates visible focus and selected state

criteria.text: Long titles/metadata, empty results, loading, errors, and read-only access remain usable; resizing does not clip essential controls.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c6: states narrow layout zoom long metadata and readonly inspection remain usable

criteria.text: Refresh and existing deep links preserve or restore the correct selection; missing/deleted items produce a clear state rather than stale details.
criteria.test_id: issue-1519-c7: deep links and refresh restore the selected integration
